versions.changelog: Add TMDB fallback for metadata-less Stremio titles and genre support

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.26.30.0 -->



**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NoahSKipp/Gelato/compare/v0.26.29.0...v0.26.30.0

- Fix prefetch cache eviction in InsertForPrefetchAsync and resolve tmdb: IDs to IMDb IDs on demand
- Run IMDb ID resolution before FindExistingItem in InsertActionFilter
- Fall back to tmdb: IDs in TMDB Discover when external_ids is missing or times out, and avoid caching transient lookup errors
- Respect PersistentMetaTtl on metadata cache reads and fix KeyLock concurrency

### Bug Fixes
- Series tree sync now refreshes existing Gelato episodes from the series meta (title, description, air date, runtime, thumbnail) instead of skipping them, so episodes first created before the metadata source had their details no longer stay blank or stale. Only Gelato stub episodes are touched, locked fields are respected, and unchanged episodes are not re-saved.

### Bug Fixes
- Retire stale stream rows on Jellyfin 12: stream lists no longer pile up hundreds of expired AIOStreams links per title (they answered HTTP 400 and made playback cycle through dead streams).
- Keep media source ids stable across syncs for AIOStreams proxy links (keyed on filename, binge group and size instead of the per-request URL).
